note: Bundleable free GRP descriptors for the startup selector. Per the design research, there are NO redistributable popular multiplayer GRPs (all popular content needs the paid base or lacks a redistribution license), so this manifest ships ONLY the free shareware GRP plus whatever the user provides. DO NOT add third-party GRPs. crc values are unsigned CRC-32 (matches grpscan.cpp). The built-in multiplayer arenas are the shareware Episode-1 DukeMatch maps already shipped in the GRP.
